title: The Loop Within
designPurpose: A restrained cyclical identity for repetition, replay, and unfinished meaning.

typography.quoteTreatment: Display serif italic in the book accent color.

mobile.toolbar: compact shared toolbar with touch-friendly controls

semanticPageTypes.frontCover: Official image appears once as first unnumbered page, object-fit contain, no crop, no theme filter.
semanticPageTypes.titlePage: Source-driven title page preserves manuscript title-page roles.
semanticPageTypes.contents: Source table of contents rendered as unboxed literary contents.
semanticPageTypes.chapterOpening: Fresh page for every chapter with concentric inset traces and repeated small return marks.
semanticPageTypes.normalContinuation: Warm paper, readable deep text, measured literary spacing, first-line indent after adjacent paragraphs.
semanticPageTypes.sectionBreak: Subtle concentric inset traces and repeated small return marks reduced to quiet marks.
semanticPageTypes.pageNumbers: Small bottom folio with cover/front matter unnumbered where required.
semanticPageTypes.finalManuscriptPage: Ending, epilogue, and about-author pages receive a softer closing surface.
semanticPageTypes.feedbackSurface: Whole-book feedback page inherits book palette and natural-height mobile behavior.

sourceAsset.format: JPEG original preserved as PNG reference

websiteAsset.optimization: Converted from official JPEG at WebP quality 88 with complete artwork preserved.

printAsset.printReadiness: Best available full-resolution reference, not genuine 300 DPI production print art for a 5.5in x 8.5in trim.

coverSpecification.availableEffectiveDpiAtReferenceTrim: approximately 186 DPI by width and 181 DPI by height, below 300 DPI target
coverSpecification.imageFitBehavior: Use object-fit: contain. Do not recolor, filter, stretch, crop, darken, or apply theme overlays.

responsiveAdaptations.mobile: Nearly full-width page, 18-22px safe padding, simplified motifs, body text no smaller than 17px, no horizontal overflow, natural-height feedback.
responsiveAdaptations.tablet: Centered page with balanced page proportions and clear chapter hierarchy.
responsiveAdaptations.desktop: 664px x 1026px page target, subtle edge/shadow, literary spacing, 60-72 character measure.

futureWordMapping.sectionBreak: concentric inset traces and repeated small return marks

futurePdfMapping.printEquivalent: warm ivory stock with book-specific muted accent motif

printLimitations: The available cover is suitable for digital and reference use but should be replaced with a higher-resolution bleed-ready cover for paperback production.
